title: Dreamy Glimmer

outfit_card.silhouette: Strapless mermaid gown with a fitted structured bodice flaring into a layered, draped tulle skirt with a sheer asymmetric front split; oversized white fur stole draping off-shoulder, cascading floor-length.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: No headpiece, but a silk ribbon choker with a beaded pendant, and elbow-length opera gloves featuring a pearl chain and crystal star charm.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: Satin bodice in deep magenta and black with a sweetheart neckline, encrusted with ruby-red crystal brooch and intricate silver floral beadwork; detached black opera gloves with pearl-strung chains and star-shaped crystal accents.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: Floor-length pink tulle skirt with pleated draping, a sheer front slit revealing a pale pink petticoat, and black opera-length gloves with pearl chain details and star charms; no visible stockings.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: Translucent pink heart-shaped bubbles floating around the dress, a crystal star charm dangling from the glove chain, and a white fur stole for dramatic volume.
